voiceModels.name: Fenrir - Cinematic British RP
voiceModels.description: Deep, authoritative British baritone with rich resonance and dramatic pacing.
voiceModels.styleGuidance: Speak in an authentic, deep British RP accent with dramatic weight, clear articulation, and measured gravitas.

trainingPrompts.text: Before the first kingdoms were carved into stone, the oceans were silent and the stars burnt cold.
Listen carefully: <breath> when the dawn bell rings, forty legions will stand upon the ridge.
Did you truly believe that iron gates could keep the mountain wind from finding you?

voiceModels.name: Kore - Warm & Natural Storyteller
voiceModels.description: Clear, balanced, melodic female voice suitable for audiobooks, essays, and conversational narration.
voiceModels.styleGuidance: Warm, engaging, and articulate delivery with natural rhythm and expressive inflection.

trainingPrompts.text: The quiet sunlight drifted through the library windows, illuminating centuries of forgotten manuscripts.
Every morning brought a new rhythm to the coastal town, from the gulls to the ringing harbor buoys.

voiceModels.name: Puck - London Cockney Streetwise
voiceModels.description: Quick-witted, agile male voice with authentic Cockney dialect and lively energy.
voiceModels.styleGuidance: Authentic East London Cockney accent, punchy cadence, lively and slightly cheeky character delivery.

trainingPrompts.text: Right, listen 'ere mate, <laugh> you can't just go strollin' into the market thinkin' nobody's watchin'!
trainingPrompts.focus: Glottal stops, diphthongs, and burst laughter

trainingPrompts.text: Proper mystery, that is. Thirty-two crates vanish into thin air, and not a soul saw a thing!
